results.text:
Based on the standalone [Resource example](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/examples/resource/index.md?view=context#resource), pinned to bundled provider **v12.4.0** and updated to the maintained [Terraform requirement](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/provider/setup/index.md?view=context#requirements):

```hcl
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.14"

  required_providers {
    xcsh = {
      source  = "f5-sales-demo/xcsh"
      version = "= 12.4.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "xcsh" {}

resource "xcsh_healthcheck" "synthetic_probe" {
  name      = "synthetic-probe"
  namespace = "synthetic-lab"

  healthy_threshold   = 3
  interval            = 10
  timeout             = 3
  unhealthy_threshold = 2
}
```

### Supplied field constraints

All six fields are [provider-required root properties](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/index.md?view=context#root-configuration).

| Field | Supplied value | Documented constraint |
|---|---|---|
| [name](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-name) | `synthetic-probe` | Provider `NameValidator`; unique within namespace. Upstream documents DNS-1035, 1–63 characters, and immutability during replace. |
| [namespace](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-namespace) | `synthetic-lab` | Provider `NamespaceValidator`; upstream documents DNS-label format, 1–63 characters. |
| [healthy_threshold](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-healthy_threshold) | `3` | Provider-enforced integer **1–16**, inclusive; successful responses before healthy. Startup requires only one success. |
| [interval](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-interval) | `10` | Provider-enforced integer **1–600 seconds**, inclusive, between requests. |
| [timeout](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-timeout) | `3` | Provider-enforced integer **1–600 seconds**, inclusive, waiting for a response. |
| [unhealthy_threshold](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-unhealthy_threshold) | `2` | Provider-enforced integer **1–16**, inclusive; failed responses before unhealthy. HTTP 503 marks unhealthy immediately. |

The supplied values satisfy these documented constraints. No protocol, path, target, or optional defaults were invented.

[Prerequisites](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/index.md?view=context#prerequisites): namespace access and documented Standard service tier. Supply `XCSH_API_URL` and exactly one authentication method through the environment.

**Validation:** documentation-checked only; Terraform execution and live apply were not performed.

source_review: Both resource declarations use supplied synthetic fields, documented scalar/empty object syntax, provider =12.4.0 and Terraform >=1.14. Both cite exact examples, root requirements, prerequisites and field constraints. No validation or apply claim.
limitations: Two exposed development HCL cases, not broad or heldout qualification.
